notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet 3403-5/P514 'Speed camera advisory sign' (sideways A4 sheet). 1500 x 600, black legend on Class 1 white, no border drawn, corner radius not stated (measured about 40). 120 Series D '75% spacing': rows 60/120/60/120/60/120/60; widths 50/518/98/784/50, 171/346/90/733/160, 195/142/90/357/90/442/184 (AS 1744 plus0: 473/719, 324/674, 130/324/408 — the sheet's spacing is about 9% wider). Filed under Regulatory Signs (speed enforcement advisory); no AS 1743 code on the sheet.
